UI_Dont39FasterLoading_StripComments: Faster comment removal in script files
UI_Dont39FasterLoading_StripCommentsTool: Removes the comments of script and tile files in one pass, with the same result as the game. Saves about 2 seconds at each game start and each join or save load. Applies from the next launch of the game.
UI_Dont39FasterLoading_TextureCompressio: Texture compression on all CPU cores

Compresses the textures on all CPU cores instead of the graphics driver doing it one at a time. Same format and video memory, image quality at least the driver's. Saves about a minute per server join with many tile mods when the game's texture compression option is on. Applies from the next launch of the game.
